name: httpserver_allow_unauthenticated_remote
description: Allow httpserve_start to listen on a non-loopback address without an auth credential, letting anyone who can reach it run any SQL.

name: httpserver_allowed_origins
description: Comma-separated origins (e.g. https://app.example.com) whose web pages may call the HTTP server, or * for any. Other cross-origin browser requests are refused. Read by httpserve_start.

name: httpserver_tls_cert
description: Path to a PEM certificate (chain); with httpserver_tls_key set, httpserve_start serves HTTPS.

name: httpserver_tls_key
description: Path to the PEM private key for httpserver_tls_cert.
